# Crushed Iron

<a href="Item-crushed-iron.md" title="Crushed Iron"><img src="icons/151.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Crushed Iron"></a>

Crushed ore from powered processing. Smelt each piece into one matching ingot; crushing doubles the ingot yield of a raw ore item.
